sources.text: CUHK-UC San Diego Joint Laboratory on Chinese Economy We invite you to learn about this new, dynamic collaboration between the Department of Economics at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and the 21st Century China Center at the UC San Diego School of Global Policy and Strategy. This lab serves as a nexus for cutting-edge interdisciplinary research, bringing together scholars and students to explore critical issues shaping China's economic landscape. Key areas of research include: Science and Technology Economic History and Development Government and Business Dynamics Legal Institutions Climate Change and the Economy The lab fosters collaboration through seminars, workshops and conferences, organizing events that bring together leading minds in Chinese economic research. It will also host scholars from each university to enhance cross-pollination of ideas and expertise. Our People The lab is led by two co-directors, Ying Bai from CUHK and Ruixue Jia from UC San Diego and scholars dedicated to the advancement of knowledge through education and research.
